parameters.content:
## Seq: Send
One item per step to send (row + step config). Writes the message log row first (unique key = enrollment:step:variant, so a rerun never sends twice), posts through Chatwoot's outreach endpoint once (no retry), then records the outcome and applies the next step / hold / exit to the enrollment itself. Returns `send_result` per row.
